
---

### ⬇️ Which file do I download?

Download **`remember-tabs-v{{VERSION}}.zip`** from **Assets** below.
Ignore *Source code (zip)* and *Source code (tar.gz)*. Those are for developers.

### Install (first time)

1. Unzip it and move the `remember-tabs` folder somewhere permanent, such as `Documents`. The browser runs the extension from this folder, so don't delete it.
   *Windows:* right-click the zip → **Extract All**, then use the inner `remember-tabs` folder.
2. Open `edge://extensions`, `brave://extensions` or `chrome://extensions` and turn on **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked** and select the `remember-tabs` folder (the one containing `manifest.json`).
4. Pin the extension and click its icon to open the side panel.

### Update from an earlier version

Replace the files inside your existing `remember-tabs` folder with the new ones, then click **↻ reload** on the extension's card.
Don't click *Remove*: that deletes your saved groups.

Full guide: [README](https://github.com/gisulan/remember-tabs-chrome-ext#readme)
